title: Find the percentage of posts created in 2011 by users from Vienna, Austria
question: Find the percentage of posts created in 2011 by users from Vienna, Austria that received negative comments (score < 60).

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.XCL_007 < 60 THEN p.XCL_026 END) AS REAL) * 100 /
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.XCL_026)
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
LEFT JOIN comments c ON p.XCL_026 = c.XCL_006
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2011'
  AND u.XCL_058 = 'Vienna, Austria'
